title: Longest K-Distinct Substring
statement:
Find the longest substring containing at most k distinct characters.

Contract
- `text` is non-null. Characters are compared exactly as Java `char` values.
- Return the length of the longest contiguous substring that contains no more than `k` different characters.
- Return `0` when `k <= 0` or the string is empty.

Examples
- `longestAtMostKDistinct("eceba", 2)` returns `3`.
- `longestAtMostKDistinct("aa", 1)` returns `2`.
- `longestAtMostKDistinct("abc", 0)` returns `0`.
hints: Use a window with two indices.
Track character counts in the current window and shrink from the left while too many distinct characters remain.
After every valid expansion, update the best length. This gives O(n) time and O(k) space.
inputSyntax: Input: text followed by k, for example: eceba 2
